scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run desktop:sync-version
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run desktop:sync-version
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run desktop:sync-version
scripts.verify: npm run verify:scripts && npm run verify:dist
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/fetch-transcripts.mjs && node scripts/fetch-releases.mjs && node scripts/sync-desktop-version.mjs
